apps.why: CUDA context + a few kernels and small copies: the compute path with no display, no video engine and no long run. Windows user work runs as Passthrough twins whose guest-visible GP_GET was measured behind the host's (claude/tdr-hunt-20261010, traces/windows_tdr_hunt_20261010/README.md, runs 263-266)
apps.ps:
$diag = @'
import os,sys,time
started=time.perf_counter()
def stage(name):
 print('STARTUP_STAGE',name,'elapsed_s=%.6f'%(time.perf_counter()-started),flush=True)
stage('process')
handles=[]
tl=os.environ.get('KF_TORCH_LIB')
if tl:
 if hasattr(os,'add_dll_directory'):handles.append(os.add_dll_directory(tl))
 os.environ['PATH']=tl+os.pathsep+os.environ.get('PATH','')
stage('dll_search')
import torch
stage('torch_import')
assert torch.cuda.is_available(),'CUDA unavailable'
print('KFDEV',torch.cuda.get_device_name(0),flush=True)
stage('torch_cuda_init')
x=torch.arange(1024,dtype=torch.float32,device='cuda')
assert float((x*2).sum().cpu())==1023*1024,'Torch GPU readback mismatch'
stage('torch_gpu_readback')
import cupy as cp
stage('cupy_import')
print('CUPY_VERSION',cp.__version__,flush=True)
c=cp.arange(1024,dtype=cp.float32)
stage('cupy_arange')
assert float((c*2).sum().get())==1023*1024,'CuPy GPU readback mismatch'
stage('cupy_gpu_readback')
print('STARTUP_DIAGNOSTIC_DONE gpu_readback=OK',flush=True)
'@
$path = Join-Path $OUT 'startup_diag.py'
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($path, $diag, [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII)
Invoke-KfExe -Exe $PY -ArgList ($PYA + @($path))
exit $global:KfRc
